name: Tang Dynasty Scenery Set
description: There is a scenic lake in Datang Street, with small bridges, flowing water, rippling blue waves, and swaying boats on the lake, which is comfortable and leisurely. There are many vendors gathering around the lake, and the place is bustling with people coming and going. Acrobatics, umbrella sellers, kite sellers, fragrant tea stalls, wine stalls, etc. gathered here, rubbing shoulders and rubbing shoulders, and the flow was endless. Use your creativity, make full use of scene sets, and create the bustling downtown in your heart!
